concepts.name: bristle
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one original, exceptionally crafted premium macOS desktop app icon for Kuizer, a developer disk cleaning tool. Concept BRISTLE. Subject: a single beautiful compact desktop dust brush, broad sweeping slightly curved ivory bristle head and a short burnt-orange enamel handle angled from lower left to upper right. The silhouette is rounded triangular at the bristles and slim at the handle, compact and designed as a recognisable logo rather than a photo of an ordinary household tool. A wide brushed nickel ferrule with two fine milled seams joins the head to the handle. Hundreds of individually modeled fine ivory bristles with warm champagne tips gently fan out in one clean diagonal sweep, detailed but the overall form stays bold and simple. Polished vermilion-orange enamel handle with a tasteful dark oval hanging hole at its upper tip. Fine hairline texture on metal, subtle enamel grain, soft bevels, warm studio top-left lighting, exquisite physically based 3D materials and contact shadows between parts. Nearly frontal view with a small amount of depth visible. Attached reference image is only for the intricate craftsmanship and object rendering style, not to copy its pencil, wand, background, or composition. Standalone brush is the entire icon, no backing tile, no rounded-square container, no badges or decorative sparkles. Genuine transparent alpha background, square 1024x1024, entire icon centered and occupying 80 percent of frame with generous margin. No text, wordmarks, letters, eraser, monogram, extra props, or watermarks.

concepts.name: ginkgo
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. One original Kuizer desktop application icon, direction GINKGO. A calm organic sculptural emblem for a developer tool that reclaims space. The subject is a single fan-shaped ginkgo leaf with one central notch and a gracefully curved short stem, sculpted from deep jade-green translucent frosted glass with warm satin brass veins. The broad organic fan is built from five softly curved lobes with tiny precise gold seams following the radial growth pattern. Delicate physical microtexture, rounded carved edges, slight thickness, dark bottle-green depth beneath lighter celadon surfaces, and restrained pale green highlights. Brass is aged warm champagne, not yellow chrome. A sophisticated collectible glass-and-metal object, tactile and restrained like an atelier desk sculpture. Near frontal view, the whole fan and short stem make one strong recognizable silhouette, slightly asymmetrical and tilted 12 degrees for character. Attached image is only a reference for how much attention to edge light, fine grain and material rendering is required; do not reproduce its letterform, colours or tile. One leaf only, isolated with genuine transparent background and no panel, no square, no badge, no text, labels, wordmarks, sparkles, neon, or other props. Square 1024x1024 canvas, object occupies 78 percent with generous margin. Strong simple form readable small. Physically based studio light from upper left, subtle natural internal reflections, beautifully controlled highlights and exquisite 3D detail.

concepts.name: pocket
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one original premium desktop app icon for Kuizer, a developer utility that cleans generated files. Concept POCKET. Subject: an elegant small open file folder constructed from thick amber optical glass, two broad overlapping faces with a distinctive stepped folder tab in the upper left. Front face is translucent caramel-orange glass with precisely polished clear bevels and a gentle concave shape. Back face is darker smoked amber with a thin brushed champagne metal rim. A single simple square pearl-white ceramic file card sits partly inside the folder, visible above the open rim with one corner clipped at 45 degrees. The folder is the entire logo and makes one compact unmistakable silhouette. Slight three-quarter view from above, mainly frontal, with generous tangible thickness, subtle amber caustics, clear light catching edges, soft contact shadows between layers, beautiful restrained satin metal reflections. Exceptionally meticulous 3D modeling and rendering, microscopic frosted grain and expensive product photography lighting. Attached reference is for glass materials and edge-light craftsmanship only, do not reproduce its monogram, letterform or square background. 1024x1024 output with genuine transparent alpha background. Centered icon occupies 80 percent of frame, margins around the complete shape. No backing tile, no extra container, no labels, no text, no letters, no watermark, no sparkles, no multiple files or decorative clutter. Original sophisticated desktop icon, not an illustration or an icon sheet.

concepts.name: aperture
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. One original premium 3D desktop app icon for Kuizer, a disk-space developer tool. Concept APERTURE: a beautifully machined circular instrument composed of exactly three broad overlapping curved shutter blades, forming a large clean open triangular aperture at the center. Outside edge is circular, blades fan around the void like a precisely assembled mechanical iris. No camera body, no literal lens glass, the abstract iris object itself is the entire icon. Material: deep cobalt-blue satin anodized aluminum on the broad faces, exposed silver microbeveled edges, darker ultramarine sidewalls, subtle precisely engraved concentric machining grain and small polished silver seam details where the blades overlap. The central aperture must be truly transparent so the background shows through, and large enough to create a clear small-size silhouette. Mostly frontal view with just enough depth to see the thickness, top-left soft-box lighting, realistic contact shadows between the metal blades, meticulously controlled specular highlights, an expensive precision instrument feel. Attached reference is for geometric clarity, sculpted depth and careful material detail only, do not copy its striped circular emblem or square tile. 1024x1024 square output on genuine alpha transparency. Icon centered and filling 78 percent of frame, generous margins. No backing tile, rounded-square plate, extra circle border, words, letters, labels, watermarks, sparkles, or additional objects. Single original finished app icon, not a sheet or UI.
